meta.title: Beautiful QR menus you update yourself
meta.description: Give your restaurant or café a fast, beautiful digital menu in Arabic and English. Change prices and photos from your phone, print the QR code, done.

hero.eyebrow: Digital menus for restaurants and cafés
hero.titleStart: A QR menu your guests will love.
hero.subtitle: Beautiful, fast and bilingual. Change a price, swap a photo or mark a dish sold out from your phone, and every table sees it instantly. No app to install, no reprinting.

demos.title: Open a real menu on your phone
demos.subtitle: These are live demo menus, exactly what your guests would see after scanning your QR code.

features.title: Everything a modern menu needs
features.subtitle: Built for owners who are busy running a restaurant, not learning software.

items.title: Instant price updates
items.desc: Edit prices, offers and availability from your dashboard. Guests see the change the moment you save.

items.title: Photos that sell
items.desc: Upload dish photos from your phone. They are optimized automatically so the menu stays fast.

items.title: Arabic and English
items.desc: A true right-to-left Arabic experience and a clean English one, one tap apart.

items.title: Light and dark mode
items.desc: Guests read comfortably in any light, and the menu follows your brand colors.

items.title: Print-ready QR codes
items.desc: Download your QR code for tables, windows and flyers. It never changes, even when your menu does.

items.title: Works on any phone
items.desc: No app, no sign-up for guests. Just scan and browse, even on a slow connection.

items.title: Your own address
items.desc: Use a subdomain like yourplace.example.com or connect your own domain.

items.title: Nothing to install
items.desc: You manage everything from the browser, on a phone, tablet or computer.

steps.title: We build your menu
steps.desc: Send us your dishes and prices. We set up your menu, your colors and your address.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.desc: Log in and edit anything whenever you like: prices, photos, offers, opening hours.

steps.title: Print the QR, welcome guests
steps.desc: Place the QR code on your tables. Guests scan and see the latest menu, always.

pricing.title: A plan that fits your place
pricing.subtitle: Every restaurant is different, so we keep it simple: tell us about yours and we will send a clear offer.
pricing.cardNote: No hidden fees. No long contracts.

items.q: Do my guests need to install an app?
items.a: No. They scan the QR code with their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser.
Within seconds. When you save a change in the dashboard, the next guest who opens the menu sees it.

items.q: Can I edit the menu myself?
items.a: Yes, that is the point. You get a simple dashboard for categories, dishes, photos, prices, sizes, offers and sold-out items. We are always here if you need a hand.

items.q: Is the menu in Arabic and English?
items.a: Both. You write each dish in both languages and guests switch with one tap. Arabic is fully right-to-left.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. You can use a subdomain of ours or connect your own domain name.

items.q: If I change the menu, do I reprint the QR?
items.a: Never. The QR code always points to your live menu, so you print it once.

cta.title: Ready to retire the paper menu?
cta.subtitle: Tell us about your place and we will have a demo menu ready for you.
